AzureAd._AllowedTenants_note: Empty = accept any Microsoft account: both Entra (work/school) organizations and personal Microsoft accounts (Outlook/Hotmail), validated by issuer shape. Populate with tenant GUID(s) to restrict.

_AzureAd_note: ClientSecret is supplied at runtime from Key Vault / App Service settings (AzureAd__ClientSecret) — never commit it.

AzureAiFoundry._RemoteTimeoutSeconds_note: Override HttpClient.Timeout for the Foundry typed client. Phi-4 Mini cold-start exceeds the default 35 s and the previous attempts timed out before first token.

AiJudge._note: When no human picks a winner within DelaySeconds of a duel finishing, this model decides and ELO moves. Verdicts it records are stored with VerdictSource=Ai so they stay distinguishable from human ones. Set Enabled=false to restore human-only verdicts. DelaySeconds defaults to 60 below — long enough for a human to read both outputs and click, otherwise the AI judge effectively decides every duel.
